title: Axiomarium trigger prompts
description: A skill's evals/trigger/prompts.yaml: prompts that should and shouldn't make an agent pick the skill, which axm triggers test runs on each harness.

skill.description: The skill the prompts are for. Must match the skill's folder name.

generated.description: Present when a model wrote the prompts: the harness and model that wrote them, and when. axm triggers generate writes it.

by.description: The harness that ran the model.

model.description: The model that wrote the prompts, as the harness names it.

date.description: When the prompts were written, as YYYY-MM-DD.

prompts.description: The prompts, each run as the first message of a session.

prompt.description: What the user asks, as they'd type it.

kind.description: positive and paraphrased prompts should pick the skill, paraphrased ones without the description's words. negative prompts are unrelated, and adversarial ones share its words but shouldn't pick it. ambiguous prompts sit between the skill and its rival.

should_trigger.description: Whether the agent should pick the skill: true for positive and paraphrased prompts, false for negative and adversarial ones, and either for ambiguous ones.

rival.description: For an ambiguous prompt only: the skill it's meant to be confused with.
